questions.questionHtml: The average height of a certain number of students in a group is 160.4 cm. If 10 students having an average height of 152.4 cm join the group and 8 students having an average height of 168.4 cm leave the group, the average height of the students in the group decreases by 2.4 cm. Find the number of students initially in the group.
questions.solution:
Let initial number of students = n

Initial total height = 160.4 n

Net change in total height:
Added = 10 × 152.4 = 1524
Removed = 8 × 168.4 = 1347.2
Net addition = 176.8

New average = 160.4 − 2.4 = 158
New number = n + 2

So,
160.4 n + 176.8 = 158(n + 2)

160.4 n + 176.8 = 158 n + 316
2.4 n = 139.2
n = 58

questions.question: Which of the following falls under the 'Original Jurisdiction' of the Supreme Court of India? 1- Dispute between the Government of India and one or more States. 2- Dispute between two or more States. 3- Disputes relating to the election of the President and Vice-President.

1- Dispute between the Government of India and one or more States.

2- Dispute between two or more States.

3- Disputes relating to the election of the President and Vice-President.
questions.solution:
Correct Answer: Option 1 & 2 only

Explanation:

The Original Jurisdiction of the Supreme Court of India is defined under Article 131 of the Constitution. It includes:

These disputes must involve a question of law or fact on which the existence or extent of a legal right depends.

However, disputes relating to the election of the President and Vice-President do not fall under the Supreme Court’s original jurisdiction. These are handled under Article 71, which provides the Supreme Court with exclusive jurisdiction, but not original jurisdiction in the same constitutional sense as Article 131.
